      "source": [
        "import random\n",
        "import platform\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import scipy\n",
        "import matplotlib\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from scipy.integrate import solve_ivp\n",
        "from scipy.optimize import minimize\n",
        "\n",
        "# Reproducibility seed and software environment log\n",
        "SEED = 42\n",
        "random.seed(SEED)\n",
        "np.random.seed(SEED)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Software Environment:\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Python     : {platform.python_version()}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  NumPy      : {np.__version__}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  SciPy      : {scipy.__version__}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Pandas     : {pd.__version__}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Matplotlib : {matplotlib.__version__}\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# 1. Allometric Scaling from Murine (Kuznetsov et al., 1994) to Human Physiology\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# Body-mass scaling factor: 75 kg adult human / 25 g laboratory mouse\n",
        "RHO_SCALE = 3000.0\n",
        "\n",
        "murine_params = {\n",
        "    \"r\": 0.18,            # Intrinsic tumor growth rate (day^-1)\n",
        "    \"beta\": 2.0e-9,       # Inverse carrying capacity (cells^-1)\n",
        "    \"gamma_T\": 1.101e-7,  # Immune-mediated tumor lysis rate (cells^-1 day^-1)\n",
        "    \"sigma\": 0.1245,      # Max tumor-stimulated effector recruitment rate (day^-1)\n",
        "    \"K_T\": 2.019e7,       # Effector recruitment half-saturation constant (cells)\n",
        "    \"gamma_E\": 3.42e-10,  # Tumor-induced effector exhaustion rate (cells^-1 day^-1)\n",
        "    \"mu_E\": 0.0412        # Effector natural death rate (day^-1)\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "# Volume-dependent rates scale with RHO_SCALE; kinetic rates remain invariant\n",
        "r = murine_params[\"r\"]\n",
        "beta = murine_params[\"beta\"] / RHO_SCALE\n",
        "gamma_T = murine_params[\"gamma_T\"] / RHO_SCALE\n",
        "sigma = murine_params[\"sigma\"]\n",
        "K_T = murine_params[\"K_T\"] * RHO_SCALE\n",
        "gamma_E = murine_params[\"gamma_E\"] / RHO_SCALE\n",
        "mu_E = murine_params[\"mu_E\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# 2. Initial Conditions, Hematopoietic Kinetics & Pharmacokinetics\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "T0 = 5.0e10   # Diagnostic tumor burden (cells)\n",
        "E0 = 2.95e9   # Baseline circulating immune effector pool (cells)\n",
        "B0 = 1.0      # Normalized baseline bone marrow reserve\n",
        "S0 = 1.0      # Normalized baseline hematopoietic stem cell capacity\n",
        "\n",
        "# Basal bone-marrow-dependent effector influx for disease-free homeostasis\n",
        "alpha_E = mu_E * E0  # 1.2154e8 cells/day\n",
        "\n",
        "# Hematopoietic recovery and cumulative stem cell exhaustion parameters\n",
        "rho_B = 0.8420       # Acute bone marrow transit recovery rate (day^-1)\n",
        "rho_S = 0.0020       # Long-term stem cell self-renewal rate (day^-1)\n",
        "delta_S = 0.1550     # Cytotoxic stem cell cumulative damage rate (day^-1)\n",
        "\n",
        "# First-order pharmacokinetic elimination rates: ln(2) / t_1/2\n",
        "lambda_C = np.log(2.0) / 1.25  # Doxorubicin surrogate (t_1/2 = 1.25 days) -> 0.5545 day^-1\n",
        "lambda_R = np.log(2.0) / 22.0  # Rituximab antibody (t_1/2 = 22.0 days)   -> 0.0315 day^-1\n",
        "\n",
        "# Summary table comparing original murine and human-scaled parameters\n",
        "scaling_df = pd.DataFrame([\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"r (day^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"r\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"Unchanged\", \"Human Value\": r},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"beta (cells^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"beta\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"/ RHO_SCALE\", \"Human Value\": beta},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"gamma_T (cells^-1 day^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"gamma_T\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"/ RHO_SCALE\", \"Human Value\": gamma_T},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"sigma (day^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"sigma\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"Unchanged\", \"Human Value\": sigma},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"K_T (cells)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"K_T\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"* RHO_SCALE\", \"Human Value\": K_T},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"gamma_E (cells^-1 day^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"gamma_E\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"/ RHO_SCALE\", \"Human Value\": gamma_E},\n",
        "    {\"Parameter\": \"mu_E (day^-1)\", \"Murine Value\": murine_params[\"mu_E\"], \"Scaling Rule\": \"Unchanged\", \"Human Value\": mu_E},\n",
        "])\n",
        "display(scaling_df)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# 1. Pharmacodynamic Saturation & 6D Coupled ODE System\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "def phi(D):\n",
        "    \"\"\"First-order saturating exponential pharmacodynamic kill function.\"\"\"\n",
        "    return 1.0 - np.exp(-np.maximum(0.0, D))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def dlbcl_ode(t, y, delta_TC, delta_TR, delta_E, delta_B, params=None):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Six-dimensional mechanistic ODE system for DLBCL chemo-immunotherapy.\n",
        "    State vector y = [T, E, B, D_C, D_R, S]\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    T, E, B, D_C, D_R, S = y\n",
        "\n",
        "    # State positivity and boundary guards\n",
        "    T = max(1e-10, T)\n",
        "    E = max(1e-10, E)\n",
        "    B = max(1e-10, B)\n",
        "    D_C = max(0.0, D_C)\n",
        "    D_R = max(0.0, D_R)\n",
        "    S = max(1e-10, min(1.0, S))\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Allow optional parameter overrides for sensitivity and virtual cohort analyses\n",
        "    p_r = r if params is None else params.get(\"r\", r)\n",
        "    p_beta = beta if params is None else params.get(\"beta\", beta)\n",
        "    p_gamma_T = gamma_T if params is None else params.get(\"gamma_T\", gamma_T)\n",
        "    p_sigma = sigma if params is None else params.get(\"sigma\", sigma)\n",
        "    p_K_T = K_T if params is None else params.get(\"K_T\", K_T)\n",
        "    p_gamma_E = gamma_E if params is None else params.get(\"gamma_E\", gamma_E)\n",
        "    p_mu_E = mu_E if params is None else params.get(\"mu_E\", mu_E)\n",
        "    p_alpha_E = alpha_E if params is None else params.get(\"alpha_E\", alpha_E)\n",
        "    p_rho_B = rho_B if params is None else params.get(\"rho_B\", rho_B)\n",
        "    p_rho_S = rho_S if params is None else params.get(\"rho_S\", rho_S)\n",
        "    p_delta_S = delta_S if params is None else params.get(\"delta_S\", delta_S)\n",
        "    p_lambda_C = lambda_C if params is None else params.get(\"lambda_C\", lambda_C)\n",
        "    p_lambda_R = lambda_R if params is None else params.get(\"lambda_R\", lambda_R)\n",
        "\n",
        "    eff_C = phi(D_C)\n",
        "    eff_R = phi(D_R)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Eq. (1): Tumor cell dynamics\n",
        "    dTdt = (\n",
        "        p_r * T * (1.0 - p_beta * T)\n",
        "        - p_gamma_T * E * T\n",
        "        - delta_TC * eff_C * T\n",
        "        - delta_TR * eff_R * T\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Eq. (2): Immune effector cell dynamics\n",
        "    dEdt = (\n",
        "        p_alpha_E * B\n",
        "        + (p_sigma * E * T) / (p_K_T + T)\n",
        "        - p_gamma_E * E * T\n",
        "        - p_mu_E * E\n",
        "        - delta_E * eff_C * E\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Eq. (3): Acute bone marrow progenitor reserve\n",
        "    dBdt = p_rho_B * (S - B) - delta_B * eff_C * B\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Eq. (4): Hematopoietic stem cell ceiling\n",
        "    dSdt = p_rho_S * (1.0 - S) - p_delta_S * eff_C * S\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Eqs. (5)-(6): First-order pharmacokinetic elimination\n",
        "    dDCdt = -p_lambda_C * D_C\n",
        "    dDRdt = -p_lambda_R * D_R\n",
        "\n",
        "    return [dTdt, dEdt, dBdt, dDCdt, dDRdt, dSdt]\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# 2. Treatment Simulation Functions\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "def simulate_fixed_cycles(delta_TC, delta_TR, delta_E, delta_B, cycles=6,\n",
        "                          cycle_length=21.0, rituximab_on=True):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Simulates a fixed-interval multi-cycle regimen (e.g., CHOP-21 or R-CHOP-21).\"\"\"\n",
        "    y_curr = [T0, E0, B0, 0.0, 0.0, S0]\n",
        "    t_all, y_all = [], []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for cycle in range(cycles):\n",
        "        y_curr[3] += 1.0  # Impulsive unit dose of CHOP (D_C)\n",
        "        if rituximab_on:\n",
        "            y_curr[4] += 1.0  # Impulsive unit dose of Rituximab (D_R)\n",
        "\n",
        "        t_span = (cycle * cycle_length, (cycle + 1) * cycle_length)\n",
        "        t_eval = np.linspace(t_span[0], t_span[1], int(cycle_length * 10) + 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "            dlbcl_ode, t_span, y_curr, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "            args=(delta_TC, delta_TR, delta_E, delta_B),\n",
        "            method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        if cycle == 0:\n",
        "            t_all.append(sol.t)\n",
        "            y_all.append(sol.y)\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            t_all.append(sol.t[1:])\n",
        "            y_all.append(sol.y[:, 1:])\n",
        "\n",
        "        y_curr = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return np.concatenate(t_all), np.concatenate(y_all, axis=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def simulate_schedule(schedule_days, delta_TC, delta_TR, delta_E, delta_B,\n",
        "                      total_horizon=140.0, init_state=None, params=None):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Simulates an arbitrary dosing schedule [t_1, t_2, ...] over a specified horizon.\"\"\"\n",
        "    dosing_set = set(float(d) for d in schedule_days if d <= total_horizon)\n",
        "    events = sorted(list(set([0.0] + list(dosing_set) + [float(total_horizon)])))\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_curr = [T0, E0, B0, 0.0, 0.0, S0] if init_state is None else list(init_state)\n",
        "    t_all, y_all = [], []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in range(len(events) - 1):\n",
        "        t_start, t_end = events[i], events[i + 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "        if t_start in dosing_set:\n",
        "            y_curr[3] += 1.0  # D_C injection\n",
        "            y_curr[4] += 1.0  # D_R injection\n",
        "\n",
        "        num_pts = max(2, int(np.ceil((t_end - t_start) * 10)) + 1)\n",
        "        t_eval = np.linspace(t_start, t_end, num_pts)\n",
        "\n",
        "        sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "            dlbcl_ode, (t_start, t_end), y_curr, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "            args=(delta_TC, delta_TR, delta_E, delta_B, params),\n",
        "            method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        if i == 0:\n",
        "            t_all.append(sol.t)\n",
        "            y_all.append(sol.y)\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            t_all.append(sol.t[1:])\n",
        "            y_all.append(sol.y[:, 1:])\n",
        "\n",
        "        y_curr = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return np.concatenate(t_all), np.concatenate(y_all, axis=1)"
      ],

      "source": [
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# Clinical Calibration Benchmarks (Day 42 / 2-Cycle Endpoints)\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "RCHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET = 2.50   # 2.5-log ctDNA clearance at Day 42 (Kurtz et al., 2018)\n",
        "CHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET = 2.07    # Scaled by GELA LNH-98.5 CR ratio: 2.50 * (63% / 76%)\n",
        "NADIR_E_TARGET = 0.8475         # Cycle 1 acute effector retention (~15.25% drop; Battella et al., 2017)\n",
        "NADIR_B_TARGET = 0.6200         # Cycle 1 acute bone marrow reserve nadir (62% of baseline)\n",
        "RECOVERY_B_TARGET = 0.8500      # Day 21 inter-cycle bone marrow recovery (85% of baseline)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def objective_stage1(theta1):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Stage 1 objective: CHOP monotherapy calibration of (delta_TC, delta_E, delta_B).\"\"\"\n",
        "    delta_TC, delta_E, delta_B = theta1\n",
        "    _, y = simulate_fixed_cycles(\n",
        "        delta_TC, delta_TR=0.0, delta_E=delta_E, delta_B=delta_B,\n",
        "        cycles=2, cycle_length=21.0, rituximab_on=False\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    T, E, B = y[0], y[1], y[2]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 1. Day-42 monotherapy tumor log-kill error\n",
        "    T_42 = max(1e-10, T[-1])\n",
        "    log_kill_42 = np.log10(T0 / T_42)\n",
        "    J_T = ((log_kill_42 - CHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET) / CHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 2. Early effector nadir error (Days 0 to 7 -> indices 0 to 70)\n",
        "    min_E_ratio = np.min(E[:71]) / E0\n",
        "    J_E = ((min_E_ratio - NADIR_E_TARGET) / NADIR_E_TARGET) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 3. Cycle 1 bone marrow nadir error (Days 0 to 21 -> indices 0 to 210)\n",
        "    min_B_ratio = np.min(B[:211]) / B0\n",
        "    J_B_nadir = ((min_B_ratio - NADIR_B_TARGET) / NADIR_B_TARGET) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "    # 4. Day 21 bone marrow recovery error (index 210)\n",
        "    B_21_ratio = B[210] / B0\n",
        "    J_B_rec = ((B_21_ratio - RECOVERY_B_TARGET) / RECOVERY_B_TARGET) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "    return J_T + J_E + J_B_nadir + J_B_rec\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Running Stage 1: CHOP Monotherapy Calibration (L-BFGS-B)...\")\n",
        "theta1_init = [1.0, 0.1, 1.5]\n",
        "bounds_stage1 = [(0.1, 5.0), (0.001, 1.0), (0.1, 5.0)]\n",
        "\n",
        "res_stage1 = minimize(objective_stage1, theta1_init, method=\"L-BFGS-B\", bounds=bounds_stage1)\n",
        "delta_TC_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt = res_stage1.x\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def objective_stage2(theta2):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Stage 2 objective: R-CHOP combination calibration of delta_TR.\"\"\"\n",
        "    delta_TR = theta2[0]\n",
        "    _, y = simulate_fixed_cycles(\n",
        "        delta_TC_opt, delta_TR=delta_TR, delta_E=delta_E_opt, delta_B=delta_B_opt,\n",
        "        cycles=2, cycle_length=21.0, rituximab_on=True\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    T_42 = max(1e-10, y[0, -1])\n",
        "    log_kill_42 = np.log10(T0 / T_42)\n",
        "    return ((log_kill_42 - RCHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET) / RCHOP_CTDNA_LOG_TARGET) ** 2\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Running Stage 2: R-CHOP Combination Calibration (L-BFGS-B)...\")\n",
        "res_stage2 = minimize(objective_stage2, [0.2], method=\"L-BFGS-B\", bounds=[(0.01, 5.0)])\n",
        "delta_TR_opt = res_stage2.x[0]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Retain variable aliases for downstream compatibility\n",
        "k_C_opt, k_R_opt, p_C_opt, rho_tox_opt = delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n\" + \"=\" * 65)\n",
        "print(\"CALIBRATED PHARMACODYNAMIC PARAMETERS\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 65)\n",
        "print(f\"  delta_TC (Cytotoxic tumor kill rate)       : {delta_TC_opt:.6f} day^-1\")\n",
        "print(f\"  delta_TR (Antibody tumor kill rate)        : {delta_TR_opt:.6f} day^-1\")\n",
        "print(f\"  delta_E  (Cytotoxic effector depletion)    : {delta_E_opt:.6f} day^-1\")\n",
        "print(f\"  delta_B  (Cytotoxic bone marrow toxicity)  : {delta_B_opt:.6f} day^-1\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Stage 1 Residual Loss                      : {res_stage1.fun:.4e}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Stage 2 Residual Loss                      : {res_stage2.fun:.4e}\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 65)"
      ],

      "source": [
        "from tqdm import tqdm\n",
        "\n",
        "# ===================================================\n",
        "# 1. Upgraded MDP Environment & State Discretization\n",
        "# ===================================================\n",
        "# Action space: inter-cycle recovery intervals from 14 to 30 days\n",
        "ACTIONS = list(range(14, 31))\n",
        "NUM_ACTIONS = len(ACTIONS)\n",
        "POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP = 21.0\n",
        "\n",
        "# Discretization bins: (T_bin, E_bin, B_bin, S_bin, dose_index)\n",
        "T_BINS = 10\n",
        "E_BINS = 10\n",
        "B_BINS = 10\n",
        "S_BINS = 5\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def discretize_state_v2(T, E, B, S, doses_given, max_doses):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Maps continuous physiological states and dose index into discrete tabular indices.\"\"\"\n",
        "    t_idx = int(np.clip(np.floor((np.log10(max(1.0, T)) - 2.0) / (11.0 - 2.0) * T_BINS), 0, T_BINS - 1))\n",
        "    e_idx = int(np.clip(np.floor((np.log10(max(1.0, E)) - 8.5) / (9.6 - 8.5) * E_BINS), 0, E_BINS - 1))\n",
        "    b_idx = int(np.clip(np.floor(B * B_BINS), 0, B_BINS - 1))\n",
        "    s_idx = int(np.clip(np.floor(S * S_BINS), 0, S_BINS - 1))\n",
        "    d_idx = int(np.clip(doses_given, 0, max_doses))\n",
        "    return (t_idx, e_idx, b_idx, s_idx, d_idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def compute_step_reward(T_prev, T_curr, B_min, E_min, is_terminal=False,\n",
        "                        T_nadir_post=None, w_kill=12.0, c_dose=2.0, w_pen=250.0):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Evaluates step and terminal rewards while strictly enforcing B_SAFE and E_SAFE\n",
        "    over the full inter-dose or post-final-dose follow-up trajectory.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    # Step tumor log-reduction reward minus administration cost\n",
        "    reward = w_kill * (np.log10(max(1.0, T_prev)) - np.log10(max(1.0, T_curr))) - c_dose\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Barrier penalties for hematological (B_SAFE) and immunological (E_SAFE) bounds\n",
        "    if B_min < B_SAFE:\n",
        "        reward -= w_pen * (1.0 + (B_SAFE - B_min) / B_SAFE)\n",
        "    if E_min < E_SAFE:\n",
        "        reward -= w_pen * (1.0 + (E_SAFE - E_min) / E_SAFE)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Terminal remission / escape evaluation over post-last-dose follow-up\n",
        "    if is_terminal:\n",
        "        T_eval = T_curr if T_nadir_post is None else T_nadir_post\n",
        "        if T_eval < 1e3:\n",
        "            reward += 500.0\n",
        "        elif T_eval < 1e6:\n",
        "            reward += 250.0\n",
        "        elif T_eval > 1e9:\n",
        "            reward -= 200.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    return reward\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def evaluate_schedule_exact(schedule_days, followup_days=POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Evaluates any deterministic dosing schedule step-by-step using the exact MDP\n",
        "    transition and reward rules, including the mandatory post-last-dose follow-up.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    state_vec = [T0, E0, B0, 1.0, 1.0, S0]\n",
        "    total_reward = 0.0\n",
        "    min_B_all, min_E_all, min_T_post = B0, E0, T0\n",
        "\n",
        "    n_doses = len(schedule_days)\n",
        "    for idx in range(n_doses):\n",
        "        t_start = float(schedule_days[idx])\n",
        "        is_last = (idx == n_doses - 1)\n",
        "        t_end = t_start + followup_days if is_last else float(schedule_days[idx + 1])\n",
        "\n",
        "        T_prev = state_vec[0]\n",
        "        t_eval = np.linspace(t_start, t_end, int(np.ceil((t_end - t_start) * 10)) + 1)\n",
        "        sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "            dlbcl_ode, (t_start, t_end), state_vec, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "            args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "            method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        state_next = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "        B_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[2]))\n",
        "        E_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[1]))\n",
        "        min_B_all = min(min_B_all, B_min_step)\n",
        "        min_E_all = min(min_E_all, E_min_step)\n",
        "\n",
        "        T_nadir_post = float(np.min(sol.y[0])) if is_last else None\n",
        "        if is_last:\n",
        "            min_T_post = T_nadir_post\n",
        "\n",
        "        step_rew = compute_step_reward(\n",
        "            T_prev, state_next[0], B_min_step, E_min_step,\n",
        "            is_terminal=is_last, T_nadir_post=T_nadir_post\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        total_reward += step_rew\n",
        "\n",
        "        if not is_last:\n",
        "            state_next[3] += 1.0  # Next D_C impulse\n",
        "            state_next[4] += 1.0  # Next D_R impulse\n",
        "        state_vec = state_next\n",
        "\n",
        "    return {\n",
        "        \"reward\": total_reward,\n",
        "        \"min_B\": min_B_all,\n",
        "        \"min_E\": min_E_all,\n",
        "        \"min_log10_E\": np.log10(max(1.0, min_E_all)),\n",
        "        \"min_T_post\": min_T_post,\n",
        "        \"min_log10_T_post\": np.log10(max(1.0, min_T_post)),\n",
        "        \"safe_B\": min_B_all >= B_SAFE,\n",
        "        \"safe_E\": min_E_all >= E_SAFE - 1e-6\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ===================================================================\n",
        "# 2. Multi-Seed Tabular Q-Learning Trainer with Convergence Tracking\n",
        "# ===================================================================\n",
        "def train_q_learning_multiseed(max_doses, seeds=(42, 101, 202, 303, 404),\n",
        "                               episodes=10000, alpha=0.1, gamma=0.99,\n",
        "                               epsilon_start=1.0, epsilon_decay=0.9995, min_epsilon=0.02):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Trains tabular Q-learning across multiple random seeds with mandatory\n",
        "    post-final-dose follow-up evaluation and logs learning curves.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    all_seed_curves = []\n",
        "    seed_summaries = []\n",
        "    best_overall_reward = -np.inf\n",
        "    best_overall_schedule = None\n",
        "    best_Q_table = None\n",
        "\n",
        "    for seed in seeds:\n",
        "        random.seed(seed)\n",
        "        np.random.seed(seed)\n",
        "\n",
        "        Q_table = np.zeros((T_BINS, E_BINS, B_BINS, S_BINS, max_doses + 1, NUM_ACTIONS))\n",
        "        epsilon = epsilon_start\n",
        "        ep_rewards = np.zeros(episodes)\n",
        "\n",
        "        best_seed_reward = -np.inf\n",
        "        best_seed_schedule = None\n",
        "\n",
        "        for ep in tqdm(range(episodes), desc=f\"Q-Learning ({max_doses} Doses, Seed {seed})\", leave=False):\n",
        "            t = 0.0\n",
        "            state_vec = [T0, E0, B0, 1.0, 1.0, S0]\n",
        "            schedule = [0]\n",
        "            doses_given = 1\n",
        "            total_reward = 0.0\n",
        "\n",
        "            # Decision epochs for inter-dose intervals (doses 1 to max_doses - 1)\n",
        "            while doses_given < max_doses:\n",
        "                T_c, E_c, B_c, _, _, S_c = state_vec\n",
        "                s_idx = discretize_state_v2(T_c, E_c, B_c, S_c, doses_given, max_doses)\n",
        "\n",
        "                if random.uniform(0.0, 1.0) < epsilon:\n",
        "                    a_idx = random.randint(0, NUM_ACTIONS - 1)\n",
        "                else:\n",
        "                    a_idx = int(np.argmax(Q_table[s_idx]))\n",
        "\n",
        "                wait_days = ACTIONS[a_idx]\n",
        "                t_next = t + float(wait_days)\n",
        "\n",
        "                # Integrate ODE across selected inter-cycle interval\n",
        "                t_eval = np.linspace(t, t_next, int(wait_days * 5) + 1)\n",
        "                sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                    dlbcl_ode, (t, t_next), state_vec, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "                    args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "                    method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7\n",
        "                )\n",
        "\n",
        "                state_next = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "                B_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[2]))\n",
        "                E_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[1]))\n",
        "\n",
        "                # Administer next dose at t_next\n",
        "                state_next[3] += 1.0\n",
        "                state_next[4] += 1.0\n",
        "                doses_given += 1\n",
        "                schedule.append(int(round(t_next)))\n",
        "                t = t_next\n",
        "\n",
        "                is_final_dose = (doses_given == max_doses)\n",
        "\n",
        "                if not is_final_dose:\n",
        "                    step_reward = compute_step_reward(\n",
        "                        T_c, state_next[0], B_min_step, E_min_step, is_terminal=False\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "                    s_next_idx = discretize_state_v2(\n",
        "                        state_next[0], state_next[1], state_next[2], state_next[5], doses_given, max_doses\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "                    best_next_q = float(np.max(Q_table[s_next_idx]))\n",
        "                else:\n",
        "                    # Mandatory post-final-dose follow-up window to capture final dose nadirs\n",
        "                    t_follow = t + POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP\n",
        "                    t_eval_f = np.linspace(t, t_follow, int(POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP * 5) + 1)\n",
        "                    sol_f = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                        dlbcl_ode, (t, t_follow), state_next, t_eval=t_eval_f,\n",
        "                        args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "                        method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "                    B_min_total = min(B_min_step, float(np.min(sol_f.y[2])))\n",
        "                    E_min_total = min(E_min_step, float(np.min(sol_f.y[1])))\n",
        "                    T_nadir_post = float(np.min(sol_f.y[0]))\n",
        "                    state_end = sol_f.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "                    step_reward = compute_step_reward(\n",
        "                        T_c, state_end[0], B_min_total, E_min_total,\n",
        "                        is_terminal=True, T_nadir_post=T_nadir_post\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "                    best_next_q = 0.0\n",
        "\n",
        "                total_reward += step_reward\n",
        "                Q_table[s_idx][a_idx] += alpha * (step_reward + gamma * best_next_q - Q_table[s_idx][a_idx])\n",
        "                state_vec = state_next\n",
        "\n",
        "            ep_rewards[ep] = total_reward\n",
        "            epsilon = max(min_epsilon, epsilon * epsilon_decay)\n",
        "\n",
        "            if total_reward > best_seed_reward:\n",
        "                best_seed_reward = total_reward\n",
        "                best_seed_schedule = list(schedule)\n",
        "\n",
        "        all_seed_curves.append(ep_rewards)\n",
        "        seed_summaries.append({\n",
        "            \"Seed\": seed,\n",
        "            \"Best Schedule\": best_seed_schedule,\n",
        "            \"Best Reward\": best_seed_reward,\n",
        "            \"Final 500-Ep Mean Reward\": float(np.mean(ep_rewards[-500:]))\n",
        "        })\n",
        "\n",
        "        if best_seed_reward > best_overall_reward:\n",
        "            best_overall_reward = best_seed_reward\n",
        "            best_overall_schedule = best_seed_schedule\n",
        "            best_Q_table = Q_table.copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return best_overall_schedule, best_overall_reward, np.array(all_seed_curves), pd.DataFrame(seed_summaries), best_Q_table\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================\n",
        "# 3. Execute Multi-Seed Training & Baseline Comparison\n",
        "# =====================================================\n",
        "baseline_eval = evaluate_schedule_exact(STD_SCHEDULE)\n",
        "print(f\"Baseline R-CHOP-21 Cumulative Reward: {baseline_eval['reward']:.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "schedule_opt6, reward_opt6, curves_6, df_seeds_6, Q_table_6 = train_q_learning_multiseed(max_doses=6)\n",
        "schedule_opt7, reward_opt7, curves_7, df_seeds_7, Q_table_7 = train_q_learning_multiseed(max_doses=7)\n",
        "\n",
        "eval_opt6 = evaluate_schedule_exact(schedule_opt6)\n",
        "eval_opt7 = evaluate_schedule_exact(schedule_opt7)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n=== Multi-Seed Performance Summary (6-Dose Protocol) ===\")\n",
        "display(df_seeds_6)\n",
        "print(f\"Optimal 6-Dose Schedule : {schedule_opt6} | Exact Reward: {eval_opt6['reward']:.2f} \"\n",
        "      f\"| Min log10(E): {eval_opt6['min_log10_E']:.4f} (Safe: {eval_opt6['safe_E']}) \"\n",
        "      f\"| Min B: {eval_opt6['min_B']*100:.2f}%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n=== Multi-Seed Performance Summary (7-Dose Protocol) ===\")\n",
        "display(df_seeds_7)\n",
        "print(f\"Optimal 7-Dose Schedule : {schedule_opt7} | Exact Reward: {eval_opt7['reward']:.2f} \"\n",
        "      f\"| Min log10(E): {eval_opt7['min_log10_E']:.4f} (Safe: {eval_opt7['safe_E']}) \"\n",
        "      f\"| Min B: {eval_opt7['min_B']*100:.2f}%\")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ===============================================\n",
        "# 4. Plot Multi-Seed Learning Convergence Curves\n",
        "# ===============================================\n",
        "def plot_convergence_curves(curves_6, curves_7, window=100):\n",
        "    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 5.5))\n",
        "    for ax, curves, title, base_rew in [\n",
        "        (axes[0], curves_6, \"6-Dose Q-Learning Convergence\", baseline_eval[\"reward\"]),\n",
        "        (axes[1], curves_7, \"7-Dose Q-Learning Convergence\", baseline_eval[\"reward\"])\n",
        "    ]:\n",
        "        # Compute rolling average across episodes for each seed\n",
        "        smoothed = np.array([\n",
        "            np.convolve(c, np.ones(window) / window, mode=\"valid\") for c in curves\n",
        "        ])\n",
        "        episodes_x = np.arange(window - 1, curves.shape[1])\n",
        "        mean_curve = np.mean(smoothed, axis=0)\n",
        "        std_curve = np.std(smoothed, axis=0)\n",
        "\n",
        "        ax.plot(episodes_x, mean_curve, color=\"navy\", linewidth=2.5, label=\"Mean Return (5 Seeds)\")\n",
        "        ax.fill_between(episodes_x, mean_curve - std_curve, mean_curve + std_curve,\n",
        "                        color=\"royalblue\", alpha=0.25, label=r\"$\\pm 1$ SD Across Seeds\")\n",
        "        ax.axhline(y=base_rew, color=\"crimson\", linestyle=\"--\", linewidth=2.0,\n",
        "                   label=\"Standard R-CHOP-21 Baseline\")\n",
        "        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=15, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "        ax.set_xlabel(\"Training Episode\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "        ax.set_ylabel(\"Cumulative Episode Reward\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "        ax.tick_params(labelsize=12)\n",
        "        ax.grid(True, ls=\"--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
        "        ax.legend(loc=\"lower right\", fontsize=11)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.savefig(\"RL_Convergence_Curves.png\", dpi=300)\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "plot_convergence_curves(curves_6, curves_7)"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# ===================================================================\n",
        "# 1. Fixed-Time Burden, Post-Dose Nadirs & Time-to-Regrowth Analysis\n",
        "# ===================================================================\n",
        "# Evaluate over a 180-day horizon to capture post-treatment nadirs and regrowth\n",
        "EVAL_HORIZON = 180.0\n",
        "REGROWTH_THRESHOLD = 1e4  # Relapse / regrowth threshold (10^4 cells)\n",
        "\n",
        "protocols_to_compare = {\n",
        "    \"Standard 6-Dose (R-CHOP-21)\": STD_SCHEDULE,\n",
        "    \"RL-Optimal 6-Dose\": schedule_opt6,\n",
        "    \"RL-Optimal 7-Dose\": schedule_opt7,\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "comparison_rows = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for name, sched in protocols_to_compare.items():\n",
        "    t_sim, y_sim = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "        sched, delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt,\n",
        "        total_horizon=EVAL_HORIZON\n",
        "    )\n",
        "    T_arr, E_arr, B_arr, S_arr = y_sim[0], y_sim[1], y_sim[2], y_sim[5]\n",
        "    last_dose = float(sched[-1])\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Post-last-dose window mask (from last dose up to last_dose + 28 days)\n",
        "    post_mask = (t_sim >= last_dose) & (t_sim <= last_dose + 28.0)\n",
        "    t_post = t_sim[post_mask]\n",
        "    T_post = T_arr[post_mask]\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Global and post-last-dose nadirs\n",
        "    min_T_idx = int(np.argmin(T_post))\n",
        "    min_T_val = float(T_post[min_T_idx])\n",
        "    min_T_day = float(t_post[min_T_idx])\n",
        "\n",
        "    min_E_val = float(np.min(E_arr))\n",
        "    min_B_val = float(np.min(B_arr))\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Tumor burden at pre-specified common timepoints (Days 105, 126, 140)\n",
        "    idx_105 = int(np.argmin(np.abs(t_sim - 105.0)))\n",
        "    idx_126 = int(np.argmin(np.abs(t_sim - 126.0)))\n",
        "    idx_140 = int(np.argmin(np.abs(t_sim - 140.0)))\n",
        "    idx_plus21 = int(np.argmin(np.abs(t_sim - (last_dose + 21.0))))\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Time to regrowth to REGROWTH_THRESHOLD (10^4 cells) after reaching nadir\n",
        "    regrowth_mask = (t_sim > min_T_day) & (T_arr >= REGROWTH_THRESHOLD)\n",
        "    if np.any(regrowth_mask):\n",
        "        t_regrowth = float(t_sim[regrowth_mask][0])\n",
        "        regrowth_str = f\"Day {t_regrowth:.1f} (+{t_regrowth - min_T_day:.1f}d post-nadir)\"\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        regrowth_str = f\">{int(EVAL_HORIZON)} days\"\n",
        "\n",
        "    comparison_rows.append({\n",
        "        \"Protocol\": name,\n",
        "        \"Schedule (Days)\": str(sched),\n",
        "        \"Min T Nadir (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, min_T_val)):.4f} (Day {min_T_day:.1f})\",\n",
        "        \"T at +21d Post-Final (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, T_arr[idx_plus21])):.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"T at Day 105 (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, T_arr[idx_105])):.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"T at Day 126 (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, T_arr[idx_126])):.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"T at Day 140 (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, T_arr[idx_140])):.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"Time to T >= 10^4\": regrowth_str,\n",
        "        \"Min E (log10)\": f\"{np.log10(max(1.0, min_E_val)):.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"Effector Drop (%)\": f\"{(1.0 - min_E_val / E0) * 100.0:.2f}%\",\n",
        "        \"Min B (%)\": f\"{min_B_val * 100.0:.2f}%\",\n",
        "        \"Marrow Drop (%)\": f\"{(1.0 - min_B_val / B0) * 100.0:.2f}%\"\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "df_comparison = pd.DataFrame(comparison_rows)\n",
        "print(\"=== Comprehensive Quantitative Comparison (Common Timepoints, Nadirs & Regrowth) ===\")\n",
        "display(df_comparison)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# 2. Generate Updated Figures 2 and 3 (Optimal 6-Dose & Optimal 7-Dose)\n",
        "# =====================================================================\n",
        "# Figure 2: Optimal 6-Dose Protocol over 126-day horizon\n",
        "t_opt6_plot, y_opt6_plot = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "    schedule_opt6, delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt,\n",
        "    total_horizon=126.0\n",
        ")\n",
        "plot_protocol_dynamics(t_opt6_plot, y_opt6_plot, schedule_opt6, horizon=126.0, prefix=\"Opt6\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Figure 3: Optimal 7-Dose Protocol over extended 150-day horizon\n",
        "horizon_7 = max(150.0, float(schedule_opt7[-1]) + 25.0)\n",
        "t_opt7_plot, y_opt7_plot = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "    schedule_opt7, delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt,\n",
        "    total_horizon=horizon_7\n",
        ")\n",
        "plot_protocol_dynamics(t_opt7_plot, y_opt7_plot, schedule_opt7, horizon=horizon_7, prefix=\"Opt7\")"
      ],

            "text/html": [
              "\n",

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ZhVva1KYCEZ3"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from scipy.stats import spearmanr, rankdata\n",
        "\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_colwidth\", None)\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.width\", 1000)\n",
        "\n",
        "# =========================================\n",
        "# 1. Direct Model-Based Search Benchmark\n",
        "# =========================================\n",
        "def model_based_beam_search(max_doses=6, beam_width=40, followup_days=POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Deterministic model-based dynamic programming / beam search directly over\n",
        "    the continuous 6D ODE state space (no state discretization) to verify global\n",
        "    optimality of the tabular Q-learning schedule.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    init_vec = [T0, E0, B0, 1.0, 1.0, S0]\n",
        "    beam = [(0.0, 0.0, init_vec, [0])]\n",
        "\n",
        "    for dose_step in range(1, max_doses):\n",
        "        next_candidates = []\n",
        "        is_last = (dose_step == max_doses - 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        for cum_rew, t_c, s_vec, sched in beam:\n",
        "            T_prev = s_vec[0]\n",
        "            for wait_days in ACTIONS:\n",
        "                t_next = t_c + float(wait_days)\n",
        "                t_eval = np.linspace(t_c, t_next, int(wait_days * 5) + 1)\n",
        "                sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                    dlbcl_ode, (t_c, t_next), s_vec, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "                    args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "                    method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7\n",
        "                )\n",
        "                s_next = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "                B_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[2]))\n",
        "                E_min_step = float(np.min(sol.y[1]))\n",
        "\n",
        "                s_next[3] += 1.0\n",
        "                s_next[4] += 1.0\n",
        "                new_sched = sched + [int(round(t_next))]\n",
        "\n",
        "                if not is_last:\n",
        "                    step_rew = compute_step_reward(T_prev, s_next[0], B_min_step, E_min_step, is_terminal=False)\n",
        "                else:\n",
        "                    t_f = t_next + followup_days\n",
        "                    t_eval_f = np.linspace(t_next, t_f, int(followup_days * 5) + 1)\n",
        "                    sol_f = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                        dlbcl_ode, (t_next, t_f), s_next, t_eval=t_eval_f,\n",
        "                        args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "                        method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "                    B_min_tot = min(B_min_step, float(np.min(sol_f.y[2])))\n",
        "                    E_min_tot = min(E_min_step, float(np.min(sol_f.y[1])))\n",
        "                    T_nadir_post = float(np.min(sol_f.y[0]))\n",
        "                    step_rew = compute_step_reward(\n",
        "                        T_prev, sol_f.y[0, -1], B_min_tot, E_min_tot,\n",
        "                        is_terminal=True, T_nadir_post=T_nadir_post\n",
        "                    )\n",
        "\n",
        "                next_candidates.append((cum_rew + step_rew, t_next, s_next, new_sched))\n",
        "\n",
        "        next_candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)\n",
        "        beam = next_candidates[:beam_width]\n",
        "\n",
        "    best_rew, _, _, best_sched = beam[0]\n",
        "    return best_sched, best_rew\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Running Direct Model-Based Search Benchmark (Continuous State Space)...\")\n",
        "mb_sched_6, mb_rew_6 = model_based_beam_search(max_doses=6, beam_width=50)\n",
        "mb_eval_6 = evaluate_schedule_exact(mb_sched_6)\n",
        "opt_ratio = (eval_opt6[\"reward\"] / mb_eval_6[\"reward\"]) * 100.0\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"  Model-Based Search 6-Dose Schedule : {mb_sched_6} | Exact Reward: {mb_eval_6['reward']:.2f} | Min log10(T): {mb_eval_6['min_log10_T_post']:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Tabular Q-Learning 6-Dose Schedule : {schedule_opt6} | Exact Reward: {eval_opt6['reward']:.2f} | Min log10(T): {eval_opt6['min_log10_T_post']:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"  Tabular Q-Learning Optimality Ratio: {opt_ratio:.2f}% of continuous-state search optimum\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =========================================\n",
        "# 2. LHS-PRCC Global Sensitivity Analysis\n",
        "# =========================================\n",
        "def compute_prcc(X, y):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Computes Partial Rank Correlation Coefficients (PRCC) between X and y.\"\"\"\n",
        "    X_rank = np.column_stack([rankdata(X[:, j]) for j in range(X.shape[1])])\n",
        "    y_rank = rankdata(y)\n",
        "    prcc_vals = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for j in range(X.shape[1]):\n",
        "        other_cols = [c for c in range(X.shape[1]) if c != j]\n",
        "        X_others = np.column_stack([np.ones(X.shape[0]), X_rank[:, other_cols]])\n",
        "\n",
        "        beta_x, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(X_others, X_rank[:, j], rcond=None)\n",
        "        res_x = X_rank[:, j] - X_others @ beta_x\n",
        "\n",
        "        beta_y, _, _, _ = np.linalg.lstsq(X_others, y_rank, rcond=None)\n",
        "        res_y = y_rank - X_others @ beta_y\n",
        "\n",
        "        corr, _ = spearmanr(res_x, res_y)\n",
        "        prcc_vals.append(float(corr))\n",
        "\n",
        "    return np.array(prcc_vals)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def run_lhs_prcc_analysis(n_samples=250, perturb_frac=0.20, seed=42):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Performs Latin Hypercube Sampling (LHS) across +/-20% parameter ranges.\"\"\"\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n",
        "    param_names = [\"r\", \"rho_B\", \"delta_S\", \"rho_S\", \"delta_TC\", \"delta_TR\", \"delta_E\", \"delta_B\"]\n",
        "    nominal_vals = np.array([r, rho_B, delta_S, rho_S, delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt])\n",
        "    n_params = len(param_names)\n",
        "\n",
        "    lhs_matrix = np.zeros((n_samples, n_params))\n",
        "    for j in range(n_params):\n",
        "        perm = rng.permutation(n_samples)\n",
        "        lhs_matrix[:, j] = (perm + rng.uniform(0.0, 1.0, n_samples)) / n_samples\n",
        "\n",
        "    low_bounds = nominal_vals * (1.0 - perturb_frac)\n",
        "    high_bounds = nominal_vals * (1.0 + perturb_frac)\n",
        "    X_samples = low_bounds + lhs_matrix * (high_bounds - low_bounds)\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_tumor_nadir = np.zeros(n_samples)\n",
        "    y_marrow_nadir = np.zeros(n_samples)\n",
        "    y_adv_log = np.zeros(n_samples)\n",
        "\n",
        "    for i in tqdm(range(n_samples), desc=\"Running LHS-PRCC Simulations\", leave=False):\n",
        "        p_r, p_rhoB, p_dS, p_rhoS, p_dTC, p_dTR, p_dE, p_dB = X_samples[i]\n",
        "        custom_params = {\"r\": p_r, \"rho_B\": p_rhoB, \"delta_S\": p_dS, \"rho_S\": p_rhoS}\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, y_opt = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "            schedule_opt6, p_dTC, p_dTR, p_dE, p_dB,\n",
        "            total_horizon=126.0, params=custom_params\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        _, y_std_i = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "            STD_SCHEDULE, p_dTC, p_dTR, p_dE, p_dB,\n",
        "            total_horizon=126.0, params=custom_params\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        min_T_opt = np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_opt[0]))))\n",
        "        min_T_std = np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_std_i[0]))))\n",
        "\n",
        "        y_tumor_nadir[i] = min_T_opt\n",
        "        y_marrow_nadir[i] = float(np.min(y_opt[2])) * 100.0\n",
        "        y_adv_log[i] = min_T_std - min_T_opt\n",
        "\n",
        "    prcc_T = compute_prcc(X_samples, y_tumor_nadir)\n",
        "    prcc_B = compute_prcc(X_samples, y_marrow_nadir)\n",
        "\n",
        "    gsa_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "        \"Parameter\": param_names,\n",
        "        \"Nominal Value\": np.round(nominal_vals, 6),\n",
        "        \"PRCC (Tumor Nadir log10 T_min)\": np.round(prcc_T, 4),\n",
        "        \"PRCC (Marrow Nadir B_min %)\": np.round(prcc_B, 4)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(f\"LHS Robustness Across {n_samples} Virtual Parameter Sets (+/-20% Perturbation):\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Mean Additional Log-Kill (RL 6-Dose vs. R-CHOP-21) : {np.mean(y_adv_log):.3f} +/- {np.std(y_adv_log):.3f} log10\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Percentage of Runs Where RL Outperforms R-CHOP-21  : {np.mean(y_adv_log > 0) * 100.0:.1f}%\")\n",
        "    display(gsa_df)\n",
        "\n",
        "    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 5.5), sharey=True)\n",
        "    y_pos = np.arange(n_params)\n",
        "    labels_tex = [r\"$r$\", r\"$\\rho_B$\", r\"$\\delta_S$\", r\"$\\rho_S$\",\n",
        "                  r\"$\\delta_{T,C}$\", r\"$\\delta_{T,R}$\", r\"$\\delta_E$\", r\"$\\delta_B$\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[0].barh(y_pos, prcc_T, color=\"crimson\", alpha=0.85, edgecolor=\"black\")\n",
        "    axes[0].axvline(0, color=\"black\", linewidth=1.2)\n",
        "    axes[0].set_xlim(-1.0, 1.0)\n",
        "    axes[0].set_yticks(y_pos)\n",
        "    axes[0].set_yticklabels(labels_tex, fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_xlabel(\"PRCC Index\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_title(r\"Sensitivity of Residual Tumor Nadir ($\\log_{10} T_{\\min}$)\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[0].grid(True, ls=\"--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[1].barh(y_pos, prcc_B, color=\"forestgreen\", alpha=0.85, edgecolor=\"black\")\n",
        "    axes[1].axvline(0, color=\"black\", linewidth=1.2)\n",
        "    axes[1].set_xlim(-1.0, 1.0)\n",
        "    axes[1].set_xlabel(\"PRCC Index\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_title(r\"Sensitivity of Bone Marrow Nadir ($B_{\\min}$)\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[1].grid(True, ls=\"--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.savefig(\"GSA_PRCC_Analysis.png\", dpi=300)\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return gsa_df\n",
        "\n",
        "gsa_df = run_lhs_prcc_analysis(n_samples=250)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# =============================================\n",
        "# 3. Clean Reward Weight Sensitivity Analysis\n",
        "# =============================================\n",
        "reward_configs = [\n",
        "    {\"Config\": \"Nominal Soft-Barrier (w_kill=12, c_dose=2, w_pen=250)\", \"w_kill\": 12.0, \"c_dose\": 2.0, \"w_pen\": 250.0},\n",
        "    {\"Config\": \"Low Kill Weight (w_kill=8, c_dose=2, w_pen=250)\",       \"w_kill\": 8.0,  \"c_dose\": 2.0, \"w_pen\": 250.0},\n",
        "    {\"Config\": \"High Kill Weight (w_kill=16, c_dose=2, w_pen=250)\",      \"w_kill\": 16.0, \"c_dose\": 2.0, \"w_pen\": 250.0},\n",
        "    {\"Config\": \"High Dose Cost (w_kill=12, c_dose=4, w_pen=250)\",        \"w_kill\": 12.0, \"c_dose\": 4.0, \"w_pen\": 250.0},\n",
        "    {\"Config\": \"Strict Hard-Barrier (w_kill=12, c_dose=2, w_pen=500)\",   \"w_kill\": 12.0, \"c_dose\": 2.0, \"w_pen\": 500.0},\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "candidate_schedules = [\n",
        "    [0, 15, 29, 46, 60, 86],\n",
        "    [0, 15, 29, 46, 64, 92],\n",
        "    [0, 14, 28, 42, 56, 85],\n",
        "    [0, 16, 31, 48, 66, 94],\n",
        "    [0, 21, 42, 63, 84, 105]\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "rew_sens_rows = []\n",
        "for cfg in reward_configs:\n",
        "    best_s, best_r, best_min_T, best_min_E = None, -np.inf, None, None\n",
        "    for cand in candidate_schedules:\n",
        "        state_vec = [T0, E0, B0, 1.0, 1.0, S0]\n",
        "        tot_r = 0.0\n",
        "        min_E_all = E0\n",
        "        min_T_post = T0\n",
        "\n",
        "        for idx in range(len(cand)):\n",
        "            t_s = float(cand[idx])\n",
        "            is_last = (idx == len(cand) - 1)\n",
        "            t_e = t_s + POST_DOSE_FOLLOWUP if is_last else float(cand[idx + 1])\n",
        "            t_eval = np.linspace(t_s, t_e, int(np.ceil((t_e - t_s) * 10)) + 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "            sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                dlbcl_ode, (t_s, t_e), state_vec, t_eval=t_eval,\n",
        "                args=(delta_TC_opt, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt),\n",
        "                method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-8\n",
        "            )\n",
        "            s_next = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "            b_min = float(np.min(sol.y[2]))\n",
        "            e_min = float(np.min(sol.y[1]))\n",
        "            min_E_all = min(min_E_all, e_min)\n",
        "            t_nadir_p = float(np.min(sol.y[0])) if is_last else None\n",
        "            if is_last:\n",
        "                min_T_post = t_nadir_p\n",
        "\n",
        "            tot_r += compute_step_reward(\n",
        "                state_vec[0], s_next[0], b_min, e_min,\n",
        "                is_terminal=is_last, T_nadir_post=t_nadir_p,\n",
        "                w_kill=cfg[\"w_kill\"], c_dose=cfg[\"c_dose\"], w_pen=cfg[\"w_pen\"]\n",
        "            )\n",
        "            if not is_last:\n",
        "                s_next[3] += 1.0\n",
        "                s_next[4] += 1.0\n",
        "            state_vec = s_next\n",
        "\n",
        "        if tot_r > best_r:\n",
        "            best_r = tot_r\n",
        "            best_s = cand\n",
        "            best_min_T = np.log10(max(1.0, min_T_post))\n",
        "            best_min_E = np.log10(max(1.0, min_E_all))\n",
        "\n",
        "    clean_intervals = [int(x) for x in np.diff(best_s)]\n",
        "    rew_sens_rows.append({\n",
        "        \"Reward Configuration\": cfg[\"Config\"],\n",
        "        \"Optimal Schedule (Days)\": str(best_s),\n",
        "        \"Inter-Cycle Intervals (Days)\": str(clean_intervals),\n",
        "        \"Min T (log10)\": f\"{best_min_T:.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"Min E (log10)\": f\"{best_min_E:.4f}\",\n",
        "        \"Objective Value\": round(best_r, 2)\n",
        "    })\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\n=== Reward Formulation Sensitivity Summary ===\")\n",
        "display(pd.DataFrame(rew_sens_rows))"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "# Virtual Patient Cohort Closed-Loop Feedback Evaluation & Excel Export\n",
        "# ==============================================================================\n",
        "def select_closed_loop_action(Q_table_trained, s_idx, s_vec, pat_dTC, pat_params, doses_given):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Retrieves Q-values for state s_idx (using nearest-visited-state interpolation\n",
        "    if the perturbed patient state lands in an unvisited tabular bin) and applies\n",
        "    a one-step patient safety filter for closed-loop adaptive scheduling.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    t_i, e_i, b_i, s_i, d_i = s_idx\n",
        "    q_slice = Q_table_trained[:, :, :, :, d_i, :]\n",
        "\n",
        "    if np.max(np.abs(Q_table_trained[s_idx])) > 1e-6:\n",
        "        q_vals = Q_table_trained[s_idx].copy()\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        visited_coords = np.argwhere(np.max(np.abs(q_slice), axis=-1) > 1e-6)\n",
        "        if len(visited_coords) > 0:\n",
        "            target = np.array([t_i, e_i, b_i, s_i])\n",
        "            dists = np.linalg.norm(visited_coords - target, axis=1)\n",
        "            nearest = tuple(visited_coords[int(np.argmin(dists))]) + (d_i,)\n",
        "            q_vals = Q_table_trained[nearest].copy()\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            q_vals = np.zeros(NUM_ACTIONS)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Closed-loop state-feedback modulation based on observed marrow & stem reserve\n",
        "    obs_B, obs_S = s_vec[2], s_vec[5]\n",
        "    if doses_given == 4:\n",
        "        target_wait = int(np.clip(round(16 + (0.60 - obs_S) * 35), 15, 22))\n",
        "        q_vals -= 5.0 * np.abs(np.array(ACTIONS) - target_wait)\n",
        "    elif doses_given == 5:\n",
        "        target_wait = int(np.clip(round(25 + (0.50 - obs_S) * 45 + (0.45 - obs_B) * 20), 21, 30))\n",
        "        q_vals -= 8.0 * np.abs(np.array(ACTIONS) - target_wait)\n",
        "\n",
        "    return int(np.argmax(q_vals))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "def run_virtual_patient_cohort(Q_table_trained, max_doses=6, n_patients=100,\n",
        "                               obs_noise_std=0.04, seed=123):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Simulates closed-loop RL treatment personalization across N=100 virtual patients\n",
        "    and exports the complete patient-level dataset to Excel.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n",
        "    cohort_records = []\n",
        "    unique_schedules = set()\n",
        "\n",
        "    for pid in range(n_patients):\n",
        "        pat_T0 = T0 * (10.0 ** rng.uniform(-0.35, 0.35))\n",
        "        pat_r = r * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15)\n",
        "        pat_rhoB = rho_B * rng.uniform(0.80, 1.20)\n",
        "        pat_deltaS = delta_S * rng.uniform(0.80, 1.25)\n",
        "        pat_dTC = delta_TC_opt * rng.uniform(0.85, 1.15)\n",
        "\n",
        "        pat_params = {\"r\": pat_r, \"rho_B\": pat_rhoB, \"delta_S\": pat_deltaS}\n",
        "        init_state = [pat_T0, E0, B0, 1.0, 1.0, S0]\n",
        "\n",
        "        t_c = 0.0\n",
        "        s_vec = list(init_state)\n",
        "        rl_sched = [0]\n",
        "        doses_given = 1\n",
        "\n",
        "        while doses_given < max_doses:\n",
        "            obs_T = s_vec[0] * (10.0 ** rng.normal(0.0, obs_noise_std))\n",
        "            obs_E = s_vec[1] * (10.0 ** rng.normal(0.0, obs_noise_std * 0.5))\n",
        "            obs_B = float(np.clip(s_vec[2] + rng.normal(0.0, obs_noise_std * 0.5), 0.01, 1.0))\n",
        "            obs_S = float(np.clip(s_vec[5] + rng.normal(0.0, obs_noise_std * 0.5), 0.01, 1.0))\n",
        "\n",
        "            s_idx = discretize_state_v2(obs_T, obs_E, obs_B, obs_S, doses_given, max_doses)\n",
        "            a_idx = select_closed_loop_action(\n",
        "                Q_table_trained, s_idx, [obs_T, obs_E, obs_B, s_vec[3], s_vec[4], obs_S],\n",
        "                pat_dTC, pat_params, doses_given\n",
        "            )\n",
        "\n",
        "            wait_days = ACTIONS[a_idx]\n",
        "            t_next = t_c + float(wait_days)\n",
        "\n",
        "            sol = solve_ivp(\n",
        "                dlbcl_ode, (t_c, t_next), s_vec,\n",
        "                args=(pat_dTC, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt, pat_params),\n",
        "                method=\"RK45\", rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-7\n",
        "            )\n",
        "            s_vec = sol.y[:, -1].copy()\n",
        "            s_vec[3] += 1.0\n",
        "            s_vec[4] += 1.0\n",
        "            doses_given += 1\n",
        "            t_c = t_next\n",
        "            rl_sched.append(int(round(t_c)))\n",
        "\n",
        "        unique_schedules.add(tuple(rl_sched))\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, y_rl = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "            rl_sched, pat_dTC, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt,\n",
        "            total_horizon=140.0, init_state=[pat_T0, E0, B0, 0.0, 0.0, S0], params=pat_params\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        _, y_fix = simulate_schedule(\n",
        "            STD_SCHEDULE, pat_dTC, delta_TR_opt, delta_E_opt, delta_B_opt,\n",
        "            total_horizon=140.0, init_state=[pat_T0, E0, B0, 0.0, 0.0, S0], params=pat_params\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        rl_min_logT = float(np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_rl[0])))))\n",
        "        std_min_logT = float(np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_fix[0])))))\n",
        "\n",
        "        cohort_records.append({\n",
        "            \"Patient_ID\": pid + 1,\n",
        "            \"Init_log10_T0\": round(float(np.log10(pat_T0)), 4),\n",
        "            \"r_day_inv\": round(float(pat_r), 4),\n",
        "            \"rho_B_day_inv\": round(float(pat_rhoB), 4),\n",
        "            \"delta_S_day_inv\": round(float(pat_deltaS), 4),\n",
        "            \"delta_TC_day_inv\": round(float(pat_dTC), 4),\n",
        "            \"RL_Schedule_Days\": str(rl_sched),\n",
        "            \"Intervals_Days\": str([int(x) for x in np.diff(rl_sched)]),\n",
        "            \"Final_Dose_Day\": int(rl_sched[-1]),\n",
        "            \"RL_Min_log10_T\": round(rl_min_logT, 4),\n",
        "            \"Std_Min_log10_T\": round(std_min_logT, 4),\n",
        "            \"Additional_Log_Kill\": round(std_min_logT - rl_min_logT, 4),\n",
        "            \"RL_Min_log10_E\": round(float(np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_rl[1]))))), 4),\n",
        "            \"Std_Min_log10_E\": round(float(np.log10(max(1.0, float(np.min(y_fix[1]))))), 4),\n",
        "            \"RL_Min_B_pct\": round(float(np.min(y_rl[2])) * 100.0, 2),\n",
        "            \"Std_Min_B_pct\": round(float(np.min(y_fix[2])) * 100.0, 2),\n",
        "            \"Grade4_Safe_RL\": bool(float(np.min(y_rl[2])) >= B_SAFE),\n",
        "            \"Grade4_Safe_Std\": bool(float(np.min(y_fix[2])) >= B_SAFE)\n",
        "        })\n",
        "\n",
        "    df_cohort = pd.DataFrame(cohort_records)\n",
        "    print(f\"=== Virtual Patient Cohort Closed-Loop Summary (N = {n_patients} Patients) ===\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Distinct Personalized Schedules Generated : {len(unique_schedules)}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Mean Final Dose Day (Range)               : {df_cohort['Final_Dose_Day'].mean():.1f} days ({df_cohort['Final_Dose_Day'].min()}-{df_cohort['Final_Dose_Day'].max()}d)\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  RL Mean Tumor Nadir (log10 T_min)         : {df_cohort['RL_Min_log10_T'].mean():.3f} +/- {df_cohort['RL_Min_log10_T'].std():.3f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  R-CHOP-21 Mean Tumor Nadir (log10 T_min)  : {df_cohort['Std_Min_log10_T'].mean():.3f} +/- {df_cohort['Std_Min_log10_T'].std():.3f}\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Mean Additional Log-Kill Across Cohort    : {df_cohort['Additional_Log_Kill'].mean():.3f} +/- {df_cohort['Additional_Log_Kill'].std():.3f} log10\")\n",
        "    print(f\"  Hematological Safety Compliance (B >= 15%): RL = {df_cohort['Grade4_Safe_RL'].mean()*100:.1f}% | R-CHOP-21 = {df_cohort['Grade4_Safe_Std'].mean()*100:.1f}%\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Plot Virtual Cohort Comparison\n",
        "    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5.2))\n",
        "    axes[0].boxplot([df_cohort[\"Std_Min_log10_T\"], df_cohort[\"RL_Min_log10_T\"]],\n",
        "                    tick_labels=[\"Standard R-CHOP-21\", \"Closed-Loop RL\"], patch_artist=True,\n",
        "                    boxprops=dict(facecolor=\"lightblue\", color=\"navy\"),\n",
        "                    medianprops=dict(color=\"crimson\", linewidth=2.5))\n",
        "    axes[0].axhline(y=3.0, color=\"darkgreen\", linestyle=\"--\", linewidth=2.0, label=r\"Molecular Remission ($10^3$)\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_ylabel(r\"Post-Treatment Tumor Nadir ($\\log_{10}$ cells)\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[0].set_title(\"Virtual Cohort Tumor Clearance (N=100)\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[0].tick_params(labelsize=12)\n",
        "    axes[0].grid(True, ls=\"--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
        "    axes[0].legend(loc=\"upper right\", fontsize=11)\n",
        "\n",
        "    axes[1].scatter(df_cohort[\"Std_Min_B_pct\"], df_cohort[\"RL_Min_B_pct\"],\n",
        "                    color=\"forestgreen\", alpha=0.7, edgecolors=\"black\", s=45, label=\"Virtual Patients\")\n",
        "    axes[1].axhline(y=15.0, color=\"purple\", linestyle=\"-.\", linewidth=2.0, label=\"Grade 4 Boundary (15%)\")\n",
        "    axes[1].axvline(x=15.0, color=\"purple\", linestyle=\"-.\", linewidth=2.0)\n",
        "    axes[1].plot([15, 35], [15, 35], color=\"gray\", linestyle=\":\", label=\"Parity Line\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_xlabel(\"Standard R-CHOP-21 Min Marrow Reserve (%)\", fontsize=13, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_ylabel(\"Closed-Loop RL Min Marrow Reserve (%)\", fontsize=13, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[1].set_title(\"Marrow Toxicity Preservation Across Cohort\", fontsize=14, fontweight=\"bold\")\n",
        "    axes[1].tick_params(labelsize=12)\n",
        "    axes[1].grid(True, ls=\"--\", alpha=0.3)\n",
        "    axes[1].legend(loc=\"lower right\", fontsize=11)\n",
        "\n",
        "    plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "    plt.savefig(\"Virtual_Cohort_Adaptivity.png\", dpi=300)\n",
        "    plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return df_cohort\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "df_cohort = run_virtual_patient_cohort(Q_table_6, max_doses=6, n_patients=100)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Display all 100 patients in the notebook output\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_rows\", None)\n",
        "display(df_cohort)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "cohort_excel_file = \"Virtual_Patient_Cohort_N100.xlsx\"\n",
        "master_excel_file = \"DLBCL_RL_All_Revision_Tables.xlsx\"\n",
        "df_cohort.to_excel(cohort_excel_file, index=False, sheet_name=\"Virtual_Patients_N100\")\n",
        "with pd.ExcelWriter(master_excel_file) as writer:\n",
        "    scaling_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=\"1_Allometric_Scaling\", index=False)\n",
        "    df_comparison.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=\"2_Protocol_Comparison\", index=False)\n",

              "    async function download(id, filename, size) {\n",
              "      if (!google.colab.kernel.accessAllowed) {\n",
              "        return;\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const div = document.createElement('div');\n",
              "      const label = document.createElement('label');\n",
              "      label.textContent = `Downloading \"${filename}\": `;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(label);\n",
              "      const progress = document.createElement('progress');\n",
              "      progress.max = size;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(progress);\n",
              "      document.body.appendChild(div);\n",
              "\n",
              "      const buffers = [];\n",
              "      let downloaded = 0;\n",
              "\n",
              "      const channel = await google.colab.kernel.comms.open(id);\n",
              "      // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "      channel.send({})\n",
              "\n",
              "      for await (const message of channel.messages) {\n",
              "        // Send a message to notify the kernel that we're ready.\n",
              "        channel.send({})\n",
              "        if (message.buffers) {\n",
              "          for (const buffer of message.buffers) {\n",
              "            buffers.push(buffer);\n",
              "            downloaded += buffer.byteLength;\n",
              "            progress.value = downloaded;\n",
              "          }\n",
              "        }\n",
              "      }\n",
              "      const blob = new Blob(buffers, {type: 'application/binary'});\n",
              "      const a = document.createElement('a');\n",
              "      a.href = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n",
              "      a.download = filename;\n",
              "      div.appendChild(a);\n",
              "      a.click();\n",
              "      div.remove();\n",
              "    }\n",
              "  "
            ]
